title: Last Person to Fit in the Bus
sourceNote: AI-authored requirements draft local-reference/leetcode/manual/1204.txt; no recovered raw statement exists in the archive (index status missing-statement).
summary: Process people in ascending turn order, accumulating weight. The answer is the name of the last person in the longest prefix whose cumulative weight does not exceed the 1000 limit. Once a person would exceed the limit, no later person may board.
inputFormat: Queue(person_id, person_name, weight, turn); turn orders the boarding sequence.
tieRules: Boarding order is strictly by turn; no tie handling is described in the draft.
edgeRules: Later lighter people cannot skip an earlier person who would exceed capacity.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.note: Weights 250,175,350,500 at turns 1..4: cumulative 250, 425, 775, then 1275 exceeds 1000. Expected: the person at turn 3. [authored-reference]
